monitoringUnitTests.scope: Pure mocked scheduling decisions; source hash checked unchanged at final freeze

wheel.metric: UI thread drawing-recording time; excludes OS composition, window activation and screenshot encoding

imageCache.limits: Private bytes include WPF/WIC/JIT and are process observations, not exact texture accounting. Cache pixel bytes estimate retained runtime bitmap surfaces; original PNG files remain full resolution. Timings include decoding/materialization, not native window switching.

limitations: Synthetic malformed configuration; not a claim about normal saves
Standalone image decode process, not product idle memory
Memory includes WPF/native decoder initialization; timings are machine-specific
No remote input or authorization bypass assessed

visualInspection.limitations: Representative fixture inspection, not all 117 assets or a live end-to-end session.

limitations: Test groups overlap; counts are not a formal coverage percentage.
No 24-hour soak, physical mixed-DPI multi-monitor, RDP, sleep/resume or elevated-window compatibility run.
No microphone-to-display or input-to-photon end-to-end latency measurement.
Native GIF validation does not claim live Terminal playback visually inspected during this review.
Strong-token pattern scan is not a full security audit.
No personal task file, current terminal text, credentials or runtime logs are included in this evidence file.
hashInterpretation: SHA-256 hashes use the tested Windows worktree raw bytes. Git CRLF conversion can change raw-byte hashes on checkout. gitBlobHashes identify the corresponding normalized Git objects for portable verification; this is not a byte-reproducible build claim.
